items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember any more? Good Night, Irene.

ctx.x: Slow music. Slow music, you know, like night, like night club. Like night club, you know, soft music. Because he used to put a music in his home and he played music. stuff Oh, I know so many numbers now. I do. When my dreamboat come home, old song, yeah. Meet me tonight in the moonlight. Old time song. That's before you were born. Yes, I don't remember that one.
Do you remember any more? Good Night, Irene.
